title: Microsoft Teams: express voice enrollment from meeting audio
summary: Hold: the governance checklist says transcription depends on enrolled profiles, but Microsoft documents transcripts containing unenrolled speakers. The roadmap facts and control paths and commands are supported; the licensing model understates the published general Teams licence requirement.

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-11-13T19:41:44.
Express enrollment creates a voice profile from speech in Teams meetings instead of requiring a separate manual recording.

claims.quote: Enrollment starts in the Teams app: users go to Settings > Recognition and, depending on how their Enterprise administrator has enabled the feature for them, opt in to either express enrollment or active enrollment.

claims.claim: Generating a voice profile from meeting speech typically takes a couple of meetings.

claims.claim: The voice profile supports speaker identification.

claims.claim: The profile supports transcription and transcript speaker attribution.
claims.quote: When an enrolled user joins meetings from a Teams Room, their contributions are accurately attributed in transcriptions, meeting recaps, and Copilot experiences.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Both EnrollVoice and PassiveVoiceEnrollment must be disabled to turn voice enrollment off completely.
claims.quote: As an organization, you have the option to Enable Active enrollment (via EnrollVoice) and/or Express enrollment (via PassiveVoiceEnrollment) for your users. To turn off voice enrollment completely, make sure to set both parameters to Disable.

claims.claim: Already-enrolled users can unenroll even after the organization disables enrollment.
claims.quote: If users enroll their voice or face profile, they can always choose to unenroll it later, even if their organization no longer allows enrollment.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk

claims.quote: If users opt to expressly enroll their voice and face profile from Teams meetings, that data will be collected on an ongoing basis

claims.claim: Teams audio and video used for express profile creation are not retained after the call ends.
claims.quote: If users enroll via express enrollment, Teams audio and video used to create voice and face profiles aren't retained after the end of the Teams call.

claims.claim: The profile is removed immediately when the user unenrolls.
claims.quote: The user’s voice and face profile is removed right away if the user unenrolls from the feature.

claims.claim: A profile unused for one year is removed automatically.
claims.quote: In addition, a voice and face profile that isn't used for one year is removed automatically.

claims.claim: Voice data is stored in the Office 365 trusted compliance store.
claims.quote: Voice data is stored in the Office 365 trusted compliance store.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not use voice and face profiles to train models.
claims.quote: Microsoft doesn't use the voice and face profiles of users to train any models

claims.claim: Microsoft uses the profiles only to provide the Teams voice and face recognition feature.
claims.quote: or for any other purposes other than providing the voice and face recognition feature in Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Voice Isolation stores an encrypted local copy of the voice profile on the user's device.
claims.quote: When a user also uses Voice Isolation on their device, a local copy of the voice profile is stored encrypted.

claims.claim: The local Voice Isolation profile copy expires after 14 days and is replaced.
claims.quote: This copy of the voice profile expires after 14 days and is replaced with a new copy of the voice profile.
